_comment: Products shown on the Store tab. Each one needs a slug: that is the folder name under media/store/ where its pictures live. Drop pictures into media/store/<slug>/ and run watch-models.bat - the watcher fills in the images list below. Everything else here you edit by hand and the watcher leaves alone.

items.title: Free Fire to Blender — Complete Course (English)
items.desc: Parts 1 + 2 in English: extract a Free Fire character, import it into Blender, apply textures, fix common texture issues, rig with Mixamo, set up fingers, and animate using Mixamo and Fortnite Porting. Step-by-step video lessons with lifetime access. Requires a PC with Blender, the extraction tools used in Part 1, Fortnite Porting, and a free Adobe account for Mixamo. Rendering is not covered.

items.title: Free Fire to Blender — Part 1: Extraction & Textures (English)
items.desc: Extract your Free Fire character, import it into Blender, apply its textures, and fix missing textures or incorrect colors. Beginner-friendly, step-by-step video lessons in English with lifetime access. Requires a PC with Blender and the extraction tools demonstrated in the course. Does not include rigging, animation, or rendering. Choose the complete course for Parts 1 + 2 together.

items.title: Free Fire to Blender — Part 2: Rig & Animate (English)
items.desc: Rig your character with Mixamo, set up the fingers, bring the rig back into Blender, and animate using Mixamo and Fortnite Porting. Step-by-step video lessons in English with lifetime access. Requires a character already imported and textured in Blender, as covered in Part 1, plus a free Adobe account for Mixamo and Fortnite Porting. Choose the complete course for Parts 1 + 2 together.

items.title: De Free Fire à Blender — Full package (French)
items.desc: The complete course in French: extract Free Fire characters, import them into Blender, add a rig, and make them move and dance. See Gumroad for the current price.

items.title: De Free Fire à Blender — Part 1/2: Extraction & Textures (French)
items.desc: Standalone Part 1 in French: extract a Free Fire character, import it into Blender, apply textures, and fix common texture issues. Does not include rigging, animation, or rendering. Choose the full package for extraction, rigging, and animation together.

items.title: De Free Fire à Blender — Part 2/2: Rig & Animation (French)
items.desc: Standalone Part 2 in French: rig your character with Mixamo, align the fingers, bring the rig back into Blender, and start animating. Requires a character already imported and textured in Blender (as covered in Part 1), plus a free Adobe account for Mixamo. Choose the full package for extraction, rigging, and animation together.

items.title: ALPHA'S PRO HUD: Layout + Sensitivity (Emulator)
items.desc: My exact Free Fire HUD layout, sensitivity and emulator settings - import it and play with the same setup I use. Instant download.

items.title: Full Bermuda Map
items.desc: The complete Free Fire Bermuda map as one Blender scene - all key locations, terrain and landmarks, fully textured and render-ready. .blend file, Blender 3.0+.

items.title: Old Peak 2020 - Free Fire Map
items.desc: The original 2020 Old Peak rebuilt in Blender - classic layout, buildings and terrain, fully textured. .blend file, Blender 3.0+.

items.title: Alpine Map - Snow & Mountain
items.desc: A winter combat environment - snowy peaks, pine forest, frozen terrain and tactical outposts, pre-textured. .blend file, Blender 3.0+.

items.title: World Cup 2026 Football Factory
items.desc: The Free Fire Factory rebuilt as a World Cup arena - field markings, goalposts and themed decoration, fully textured. .blend file, Blender 3.0+.

items.title: Social Island
items.desc: A fully textured recreation of the Free Fire Social Island - themed zones, hangouts and mini-game areas, render-ready. .blend file, Blender 3.0+.

items.title: Lone Wolf Map Pack
items.desc: Multiple 1v1 arena environments including the Iron Cage - full textures and clean shader setups. .blend files, Blender 3.0+.
